title: Operation response
description: POST /operations/{name} reply. Thin by design: there is no field for the target's error payload. Every effect: read operation answers result, and under no other key. A preview (feature calls) answers what the confirm would: outcome succeeded or no_change, and result the would-be record; nothing is recorded.

account_id.description: The id of the account an adoption bound, or a release let go of when one was bound.

result.description: Every effect: read operation's answer, and a physical operation's record. Validated against the schema registry/operations.json names for the operation: common/records.json, common/activity.json, common/status.json, a kind profile's (profiles/storage/status.json), or its own.
